# Vince Molinari

> Vince Molinari is a Wall Street veteran, serial entrepreneur, and globally recognized authority on capital markets, digital assets, and sustainable finance. He is the Founder & CEO of FINTECH.TV, a global fintech media company broadcasting from a permanent studio on the floor of the New York Stock Exchange — one of only five such studios in NYSE history.

## Key facts
- 30+ years as a licensed securities professional, beginning at Lehman Brothers in 1988.
- Founder & CEO of FINTECH.TV, with studios at the NYSE, NASDAQ, LSEG (London), and ADGM (Abu Dhabi).
- FINTECH.TV's flagship program, the Digital Asset Report, has reached 4M+ viewers worldwide.
- Pioneered the first FINRA-approved broker-dealer and Alternative Trading System (ATS) for digital securities in the U.S., through Templum, Inc.
- Testified before the U.S. House Committee on Financial Services; authored SEC and FINRA comment letters.
- Digital Assets Board Member, U.S. Chamber of Commerce (Center for Capital Markets Competitiveness).
- Three-time Master of Ceremonies for Fintech Day at Abu Dhabi Finance Week.
- Co-Founder & Executive Vice-Chair, Blockchain Commission for Sustainable Development (co-founded at the United Nations General Assembly, 2017).
- Chairman of the Board, Phunware (NASDAQ: PHUN).
- Available for keynotes, fireside chats, panel moderation, MC/hosting, and executive briefings on capital markets, digital assets, AI in finance, and the Middle East as a rising global financial center.
